ABOUT THE ROLE

LiveX AI is building realtime, interactive AI avatars: digital humans that see, listen, and respond with natural speech and expressive motion. This engineer trains, fine-tunes, and serves the generative models behind these avatars across the full model lifecycle, from data curation and training diffusion, video, and multimodal models to low-latency inference for live streaming.


RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Train and fine-tune generative models for talking-head synthesis, audio-driven facial animation, and full-body avatar video (diffusion models, DiT, 3D Gaussian Splatting, GAN-based, transformer-based video generators).

 - Design data pipelines for large-scale video, audio, and multimodal datasets: collection, cleaning, labeling, alignment, augmentation.

 - Optimize models for realtime serving with sub-200ms end-to-end latency: distillation, quantization, pruning, caching, streaming inference, custom CUDA/Triton kernels where needed.

 - Build and maintain training, evaluation, and deployment infrastructure on GPU clusters (PyTorch, DeepSpeed, FSDP, Ray, Kubernetes).

 - Define and track quality metrics (lip-sync accuracy, identity preservation, expression naturalness, latency, throughput) and drive measurable gains.

 - Work with backend, product, and research teams to ship avatar features and iterate on user feedback.

 - Keep up with research in generative video, multimodal AI, and neural rendering; bring useful techniques into the stack.


QUALIFICATIONS

 - 3+ years of hands-on ML engineering, or strong research experience with production-quality code, with a record of shipping deep learning models.

 - Deep expertise in PyTorch and modern DL workflows; able to read, reproduce, and extend research papers.

 - Strong background in one or more of: diffusion models, video generation, generative AI, computer vision, multimodal (audio+vision) AI, speech synthesis, neural rendering.

 - Solid Python engineering; distributed training on multi-GPU / multi-node setups.

 - Proven realtime inference optimization: TensorRT, ONNX, Triton Inference Server, CUDA, mixed precision, streaming pipelines.

 - Comfortable in ambiguous, fast-changing environments; proactive, ownership-driven.

 - Fast-learning startup mentality; eager to push what interactive avatars can do.


NICE-TO-HAVES

 - Talking-head, audio-driven animation, lip-sync, or digital human systems; 3D Gaussian Splatting, NeRF, face reenactment, avatar synthesis.

 - Publications at top venues (NeurIPS, CVPR, ICCV, SIGGRAPH, ICLR, ICML) or notable open-source contributions.


COMPENSATION

Competitive salary, equity, and benefits; access to substantial GPU compute. No range listed. Equal Opportunity Employer.


HOW TO APPLY (ORIGINAL POSTING)

Email resume and relevant supporting materials to career@livex.ai, subject "Candidate Application - AI Engineer".
